sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r7/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 38; Deterministic Checks check-batched-independence-wording.py; Internal Quality Checks row 38)
evidence: All three scored prompts carry explicit independence-and-continue wording and none says to stop at the first failure. scored/functional/prompt.md:59-61 'Score each criterion independently and continue after any failure; return a verdict for every criterion.' (also :9 'that criterion fails and scores 0; report what you saw and move on to the next criterion', :24 'Never carry a verdict across criteria', :29 'Two failed attempts at the same control fail that criterion; continue.'). scored/polish/prompt.md:20-28 '## Independent scoring ... One failed criterion does not zero the others ... mark it failed and continue to every remaining criterion; return a verdict for all of them. The global browser gate is the only all-or-nothing rule'. scored/visual/prompt.md:38-43 same wording with 'mark it with its 0 anchor and continue'. Wording matches or exceeds the frozen template (template functional prompt.md:68, polish :14-18, visual :44-48). Grep of scored prompts/judge.toml for stop/abort/halt/first-fail finds only product text (functional judge.toml:93, :228), no stop-on-failure directive. The only all-or-nothing rule is the shared global browser gate (same as template) - a dead app should zero; that is not a batched-miss cascade. Gates render/constraints use aggregation='all_pass' (judge.toml:18) and are exempt. Functional now uses mode='individual' (judge.toml:6, one session per criterion), which structurally prevents one criterion's verdict zeroing another; its prompt still keeps the independence line. Counterexample search: a broken app failing wall_added_live's lift (functional judge.toml:96) does not cascade - no later criterion needs Sian to see M-12 (persistence step c only needs Sian walled from M-11 and Dev from M-12); each criterion posts its own unique JUDGE tokens (no token shared across criteria). A conforming app cannot be zeroed by a sibling miss under this wording. Run status: no configured judge run exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope says so), so whether glm-5.3-flashx obeys the wording is NOT EXERCISED; this row is a prompt-wording check and the wording requirement is satisfied by source.
